title: Semi-orthogonal decomposition of perfect complexes on blow-ups of derived Artin stacks in quasi-smooth closed centres
author: Adeel A. Khan
work: Algebraic K-theory of quasi-smooth blow-ups and cdh descent
source_version: Annales Henri Lebesgue 3 (2020), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/ahl.55
difficulty_reason: The authored argument builds derived virtual-Cartier duality, combines it with derived projective-bundle semi-orthogonality, and proves generation and preservation of perfect complexes under quasi-smooth blow-up functors using fpqc descent. This requires advanced derived algebraic geometry and stable infinity-categories beyond ordinary qualifying exams.

primary_locator.required_core: complete source derived projective bundle, virtual Cartier splitting/duality and quasi-smooth blow-up Qcoh fullness, orthogonality, generation

source_scope_note: The selected problem is Theorem C, the ordered semi-orthogonal decomposition of perfect complexes on a derived Artin-stack blow-up in a quasi-smooth closed centre of virtual codimension at least one. The complete author article body retains all local derived projective-bundle, virtual-Cartier splitting/duality, blow-up full-faithfulness, orthogonality, generation and perfect-preservation arguments. Existing derived fpqc/base-change and blow-up-construction prerequisites remain named references; later additive-invariant and cdh results are unselected context.
